answer: Picture a lantern swung at random through a dark garden: each epoch a public beacon draws one in two hundred keys for a deep audit. That operator joins a live call with a bonded notary, shows the machine holding the key, and answers questions about its recent jobs. Skipping or failing forfeits all locked earnings, and any other key found on that same hardware is frozen too. A farmer hiding fifty keys faces fifty draws, so the walnut shell of anonymity cracks fast.
